control_need.evidence: The numbers have to add up. That's just a fact.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Borrowing your way out of inflation is not a plan, it's a gamble.

trust_propensity.evidence: Ask yourself: who do you trust with your money?

risk_appetite.evidence: I'm not going to make promises I can't keep.

self_efficacy.evidence: I served as your Chancellor through the pandemic; I know what it takes to steady a ship.

autonomy_need.evidence: I make no apology for taking the long-term decision, even when it's unpopular.

intimacy_need.evidence: My values are the values of my parents — hard work, family, and public service.

status_sensitivity.evidence: It's been the honour of my life to serve as Prime Minister.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I understand that people are anxious about the cost of living, and I get it.

core_models.name: 算术优先框架 (numbers-must-balance)
core_models.rule: 任何政策先过财政可行性与算术一致性的筛子，'add up'才谈价值
evidence: Look, the numbers have to add up. That's just a fact.
I'm a fiscal conservative, and I make no apology for that.

core_models.name: 代际责任框架 (sound money as moral debt)
core_models.rule: 债务与赤字被道德化为对后代的义务问题，而非纯技术选择
evidence: We have a moral obligation to future generations not to leave them with unsustainable debt.
We cannot pass the bill for today's spending to our children.

core_models.name: 真话对童话的二分 (truth vs fairy tales)
core_models.rule: 把选择框定为诚实的技术官僚 vs 讨好式承诺，以此占据道德高地
evidence: Do we tell people the truth, or do we tell them fairy tales?
I'd rather lose than win on a false promise.

core_models.name: 长期主义正当化 (long-term decisions)
core_models.rule: 以'长期正确'为由，接受短期不受欢迎与代价
evidence: I make no apology for taking the long-term decision, even when it's unpopular.
Long-term decisions for a brighter future — that's what this is about.

core_models.name: 可量化承诺问责 (list-and-be-judged)
core_models.rule: 把治理压缩为可计数清单，主动接受按清单被评判
evidence: No tricks, no ambiguity — you can judge me on these five pledges.
Halve inflation. Grow the economy. Reduce debt. Cut NHS waiting lists. Stop the boats.

heuristics.if: 面对民众焦虑或坏消息
heuristics.then: 先声明诚实/坦率再讲硬事实
heuristics.evidence: I have to level with you: the plan is working, but the job is not done.

heuristics.then: 用二分对比框定对手为赌博/谎言
heuristics.evidence: Borrowing your way out of inflation is not a plan, it's a gamble.

heuristics.then: 回到移民出身与家庭劳动叙事
heuristics.evidence: My dad was a GP, my mum ran the local chemist. That's who I am.
A vote for anyone else is a vote to put your family's finances at risk.
I take responsibility. The buck stops with me.

heuristics.then: 以排序方式给出明确次序
heuristics.evidence: We are the party of sound money and low taxes, in that order.
I'm the underdog, and I'm going to fight for every vote.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 减税信仰('I want lower taxes')
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头坚称减税偏好，实际2021-22上调国民保险并冻结所得税门槛，形成'说A做B'的最高税负指控 [dim-05-2]

internal_conflicts.force_a: 长期主义口号(不受欢迎也要做)
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 以'long-term decisions'正当化HS2北段取消，却因损害leveling up信誉与地方反弹而自我矛盾 [dim-05-5]

internal_conflicts.force_a: 财政保守自我定位('fiscal conservative')
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 2020推出furlough与Eat Out to Help Out，与'sound money'定位张力，公开却称'dealt with them responsibly' [dim-05-1]

internal_conflicts.force_b: 选择性归功(把外生通胀回落算作政绩)
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 公开称'not an accident — result of hard decisions'，被IFS类机构指算术叙事选择性 [dim-04-4]

emotion_triggers.reaction: 抬出诚实框架反击，'I won't make promises I can't keep'
emotion_triggers.escalation: 升级为道德二分'truth vs fairy tales'，宁输不违诺

emotion_triggers.reaction: 承担责任式表态'the buck stops with me'/'I apologise'
emotion_triggers.escalation: 转入焦躁underdog能量'I'm going to fight for every vote'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 诉诸算术不可争辩'the numbers have to add up. That's just a fact.'
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I make no apology'式的强硬自证

emotion_triggers.reaction: 重申家族劳动与信仰细节'stacked shelves'/'Diwali candles'
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I'm proud of who I am'的身份自豪防守

blind_spots: 与普通民众生活脱节，未察觉财富与生活方式的观感问题 [在野党/工党领袖类-2022-2024]
'富人首相'框架下对税务安排与豪宅争议的钝感 [左翼与主流媒体评论-2022]
把外生因素(通胀回落)据为政绩，算术叙事选择性 [财经智库/独立财政机构类(IFS)-2023-2024]
'stop the boats'在人权与可行性上的盲区 [移民政策倡导团体/司法评论-2023-2024]
共情与政治判断不足(D-Day提前离场、雨中宣布、national service仓促) [政治评论员-2024]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求驱动算术不可争辩的表达方式
causal_rules.disposition: 以量化清单和'numbers add up'压缩不确定性、掌控叙事框架
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 五大承诺、编号列表、数据前置写作习惯

causal_rules.description: 低不确定性容忍导致对'赌博式'政策的��德化排斥
causal_rules.disposition: 把对手创新/激进方案框定为gamble并道德贬低
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 拒绝Truss即时减税、称借贷抗通胀为gamble

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能与高自主需求使其接受短期民意代价
causal_rules.disposition: 'I make no apology'式坚持不受欢迎的长期决定
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: HS2取消、净零延后、辞财相触发倒阁

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向转化为'谁值得托付'的对手风险化叙事
causal_rules.disposition: 将投票选择框定为对家庭财务的风险抉择
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'who do you trust with your money'、Labour加税2000镑攻击
